source_protocol.fit_scope: one source orbit per transfer; one globally consistent target-orbit alpha route chosen from source-only directions
source_protocol.selection: source-gate-only over fine target-orbit alpha tuples; minimum total alpha then KS and source error; outer-independent
source_protocol.input_representation: source-standardized telemetry concatenated with per-unit earliest-window baseline-relative trajectories

promotion_gate.rule: all six component-orbit folds must have RMSE and MAE no greater than the frozen reference
